verdict.rationale: HubSpot docs confirm you can connect an individual work email (Gmail/Outlook) to send emails from the CRM and log replies automatically to records (hubspot-docs-13/21/46), which covers the core email-sync and auto-logging use case. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on true two-way sync mechanics, contact-matching logic, or edge cases, so the depth of the capability isn't fully substantiated.
